title: Patent in-text citation function
description: One row per candidate citation window in a patent description. Produced by prompts/label_citation_function.md.

cited_doc_type.description: What kind of document the window cites. 'mixed' when papers and patents are cited together; 'none' when the regex cue is not a citation.

function.description: Primary role the cited work plays for the invention (see prompt for definitions).

cited_work_string.description: The citation as written, verbatim (first one if several).

note.description: One sentence giving the reason for the label.
